title: Minimum Difficulty of a Job Schedule
description: Partition an array into d subarrays to minimize the sum of the maximums of each subarray.
pseudocode:
1. If length < d return -1
2. Initialize dp table with infinity
3. Base case: day 1 difficulty = max(jobDifficulty[0...i])
4. For day = 2 to d:
5.   For i = day-1 to n-1:
6.     For j = day-2 to i-1:
7.       dp[day][i] = min(dp[day][i], dp[day-1][j] + max(jobDifficulty[j+1...i]))

steps.note: Day 2, Job 5: Split at index 4. Max(6,5,4,3,2) + 1 = 6 + 1 = 7.
